scope: Water source and documentation routing for one vending identity and four recipe-water instances. No numerical water rules or legal approvals are added.

vending2019.role: Original final notification; incorporation and scope

records.sourceReviewResult: The original 2019 FPSFA 2.10.9 notification incorporates IS 10500 and excludes packaged drinking water, natural mineral water and installations for captive consumption. BIS metadata identifies IS 10500:2012, reaffirmed August 2023, with four amendments. The June 2025 replacement tables retrieved here are draft text; they are not activated.
records.sourceReviewNextAction: Reconcile the complete IS 10500 normative text and all four amendments, and establish any final FSSAI replacement and commencement before assigning water limits. Ingredient-water FAQ documentation concessions do not establish vending-water compliance.

records.sourceReviewResult: The recipe water now has an official ingredient-water documentation anchor: FoSCoS FAQs 121–123, page 18. Supplier type changes the required evidence; municipal bill concessions do not prove potability or resolve ingredient CTR applicability.
records.sourceReviewNextAction: Identify the actual water supply and point of use, retain the appropriate bill or water report, and reconcile IS 10500 and its amendments. Do not inherit packaged or mineral-water numerical limits or transfer ingredient-water results to the finished recipe.
